title: Japanese Money Methods
note:
THE DEBUNK. Same argument as the -hi chapter 3 and the same four drawn
     layers, because the claims are identical: a 90/3 split, 51% of a whole,
     a 25-year window inside eight decades, and a count of five.

     Ground arc: neutral warm -> amber under examination -> red -> amber, held
     across s25/s26 -> cool on the half nobody shows -> red -> amber on the era
     -> red hot at the peak -> red on the quote -> neutral paper for the five
     reasons -> green on the honest line.

     Archetypes: A B A B B A A D B A D A.
